selectLanguageDescription: Select the language for the installation process and the default site language.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Check that your server environment meets the requirements for running HAX.
allRequirementsMet: All requirements are met. You can continue to the next step.
configureSystemDescription: Set up your administrator account for the new HAX site.
passwordHelp: Leave blank for an auto-generated secure password, or enter 10+ characters with at least one letter and one number.
installationComplete: Installation complete! Here are your credentials.
saveCredentialsWarning: Important: Save these credentials now. This is the only time they will be displayed.
languageHelp: Type a name, native name or code.
usernameHelp: Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.
versionAfterSignIn: The HAXcms version and full server paths show in system admin after you sign in.
foreverFiles: Your sites are plain files in _sites, tracked with git from day one.
foreverStandards: Built on web standards, so what you make keeps working as HAXcms updates.
foreverPortable: Take a site anywhere: it runs on HAXcms in PHP or Node, or as static files.
foreverPillar: Sustainable: built to last, light on the planet.
tvArtCredit: Future Traveler art from haxtheweb/art. The TV looks the same in light and dark.
padB: B: take back the last block
padNote: HAX Blocks on channel 2: race three rivals for the HAX blocks. A grabs (or bonks a rival next to you), B takes one back, Select remixes your fighter, Start publishes. Your keyboard works too: arrows, A and B light up the button they press.
tipDifferenceTitle: The HAX difference: what you make keeps working
tipDifference: Your pages are web-standard HTML in plain files you own, tracked with git. Nearly every site built with HAX since 2020 still works today, and a site moves between HAXcms in PHP, in Node or static hosting as it is. Built to last, light on the planet.
tipFilesTitle: Bring your files and make them HAX
tipFiles: After install, Import on the dashboard turns these into a HAX site you can edit, remix and take anywhere.
tipSites: Point Import at a site's address and its pages come in as HAX pages and blocks.
tipBooksTitle: Books and docs come in too
tipBooks: Open textbooks and docs-as-code repos become a HAX site with their outline intact.
tipPassword: The last step shows your new login one time. Keep it in a password manager before you start HAXcms.
